content.title: AtriCure (ATRC) Margin Miss Challenges Hopes for Near-Term Profitability Despite Strong Growth Forecasts
content.summary: AtriCure (ATRC) continues to operate at a loss, with net losses growing at an annualized rate of 12.8% over the past five years and no improvement in net profit margin during the last year. Even so, revenue is projected to rise 11.6% per year, outpacing the broader US market’s 10.3% expected growth, and earnings are set for rapid expansion with forecasts calling for a 76.64% annual profit growth rate and a return to profitability within three years.
